Both reviews are submitted to the hub. Summary:

**V2 task (task-c3036b596fda4cff9bf237cfb36c649a) — verdict REWORK, error_count 1**

Independent blind solve (before reading any keys) matched all four writer-v2.json answers: La Dolce Vita/Mastroianni-Rubini, The Apartment/MacLaine-Kubelik, Gospel Train/Rosetta Tharpe, Hound Dog 1953/Big Mama Thornton. No duplicate facts found in a repo-wide RU/EN scan.

One real factual problem found: music-021's premise "альбом Gospel Train, изданный **Mercury Wing** в 1956 году" is very likely wrong — English Wikipedia gives the original 1956 release as plain **Mercury MG-20201**; Wing only became Mercury's budget-reissue imprint from **1958**, so a Wing pressing is almost certainly a later reissue, not the 1956 original. I couldn't open the Rock Hall catalog page myself (403 on every attempt) to see whether that's where the error originated.

Secondary editorial note (not an error): "Марчелло Рубини" shares a first name with "Марчелло Мастроянни," letting a player pattern-match the answer without film knowledge.
